title: Female borrowers who specify the use of certified or high-quality inputs fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the number of children they have may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include their specific age in the pitch may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide specific family details, such as children's count or spouse's employment, may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide specific personal details like age or number of children may fund faster.
Specifying the purchase of specific equipment or machinery predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention broad goals like food security or environmental impact may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific financial pressures like rising costs may fund faster.
Pitches from women that provide detailed lists of specific products, materials, or inventory quantities are associated with slower funding speeds.
Female borrowers who specify technical attributes (e.g., waterproof, certified) of their purchases fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
